name: It Girl
storyline:
Explore Holborn, a city inspired by 1990s London. Lose yourself in environments that contrast bright lobbies and detailed dressing rooms with museum vaults and the abandoned subway stations connecting the levels.

Beware of enemies: The tension and survival instincts are driven by foes who will relentlessly pursue you until they catch you. They react with visible damage effects when hit by Nina’s limited taser charges, so every battery counts.
summary: It Girl is a dramatic adventure defined by tense exploration and puzzle-solving mechanics. Play as Nina Tate, a socialite abandoned by her family and standing at a crossroads, as she carries out a series of acts of sabotage to keep her lifestyle afloat. Crafted in the style of a classic horror game, It Girl features a story-driven mode that immerses you in an ironic, satirical narrative.
